programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1984, a passerby finds the torso of a woman in a cardboard box. A forensic entomologist analyzes nearby insect activity to determine when the victim was killed.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Digital enhancement of security camera footage shows that what appears to be a casual encounter is actually a forced abduction. When investigators suspect the crimes are not random, they fear a serial killer may be on the loose.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 2001, Ginger Hayes and her infant son were abducted during a carjacking. The crime had been reported by a witness within minutes of occurrence.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1991, Dorothy Donovan was murdered in her Dover, Delaware home. When her son stated that she was murdered by a hitchhiker he had picked up, police were skeptical.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: At the scene of a vicious murder, the killer went to a great deal of effort to wipe away his fingerprints and obscure his shoe impressions left when he tracked blood trails on the floor.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A wealthy man and his wife were attacked by three masked men outside their luxurious Louisiana home. He was shot dead and she was forced to open their hidden safe. To solve the crime, police would have to find out who knew about the concealed safe.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Police instituted an intense search when the mother of two young children went missing. Twenty years after her body was found, new technology recontextualized old evidence and pointed directly to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When Leann Fletcher is found dead, investigators use blood spatter analysis and forensic computing to find a motive for her murder: her husband, a prominent lawyer, was having an affair with judge Susan Chrzanowski.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When Washington, DC is plagued by a series of arson fires — each started with the same type of incendiary device — it's up to forensic scientists to find the clues that lay in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1992, Laura Houghteling disappeared from her Bethesda home and was never seen again. Forensic scientists use evidence from her bedroom to direct police to a prime suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A woman is found dead in a ravine, and crucial evidence has been washed away by severe thunderstorms. Twice, the trail turns cold. Almost 20 years later, an old hat and a chip of stainless steel brings the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 2002, a small community in upstate New York was devastated when Patty Wlasiuk died in a truck accident. But burdock seed pods found in her hair and on her clothes indicated that this was no accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1992, 22-year-old Dawn Bruce is brutally murdered in her Virginia apartment. Investigators notice a blood smear on a pillow case that appears to have been made by one of the killer's fingers.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1984, California firefighters battled ten arson fires in three weeks. When cigarettes and a scrap of paper connected the case to similar fires further north, the hunt was on for a dangerous pyromaniac.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When a fire destroyed most of a home and a young boy went missing, police organized the largest search in the history of their small town. First the boy's backpack was discovered five miles from home, then his body was found 50 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1996, a federal agency ruled that Terri Strickland had intentionally set the fire that killed her 17-month-old son, Josh Hinson. Using the then-emerging resources of the internet, Strickland undertook her own investigation.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Haunted by the disappearance of her mother, a young woman undertakes an investigation of her own. In her mother's diary, she discovers a dark family secret that might explain the disappearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A woman is shot to death in her store just one day before she is to testify against the man accused of robbing her. The robber becomes the prime suspect, but he has a solid alibi: a timestamped videotape of his activities on the day of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A mother of two young children was found dead in her bedroom. Her death was ruled a suicide — but when investigators learned she had almost died in a house fire three years earlier, they decided to take another look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When a young girl was found dead, police quickly arrested the most likely suspect. But cutting-edge technology from NASA enabled a forensic odontologist to prove the wrong man was behind bars.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Several suspects and conflicting evidence complicated a brutal murder investigation. But the forensics were clear on one thing: the killer knew his victim, and that alone gave investigators a head start.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Sometime during a neighborhood Christmas party, five-year-old Melissa Brannen disappeared. Investigators turned to forensic science to help them see what the witnesses missed.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When a wealthy socialite died after falling down the stairs, witness accounts contradicted evidence. To find out what really happened, investigators employed a physicist and an expert in accident reconstruction.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Welcome Intrusion
programme.desc: A man tells police he shot an intruder who had attacked and murdered his wife. The husband paints a tragic picture and is dubbed a hero. Four years later, forensic evidence leads police to re-examine the motives of this so-called hero.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Time of death becomes pivotal after a pregnant woman is found murdered in her air-conditioned bedroom. A striking similarity between her death and an HBO movie gives examiners the clues they need to thaw out the alibi of a cold-blooded killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El capitán Bernal llama al comandante Salas para informarle que Martin Del Valle estuvo en Colombia con Emiliano y que hallaron un cómplice llamado Fernando. Por otro lado, Virginia encuentra en la oficina de Carlos el sobre con la plata para Raquel.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano presiona a Fernando para que le diga a Letty lo que siente o de lo contrario podría perderla. Por otro lado, Carlos descubre que han sacado el sobre con la plata para Raquel.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El Coloso recibe una noticia por parte de Carmen Román donde asegura tener un hijo de él. El Coloso decide rechazar la paternidad del hijo que Carmen menciona. Por otro lado, la policía busca a Fernando Molina para interrogarlo.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Carmen llega con Roro al bar Garibaldi, ella no quiere irse hasta que Manuel oiga cantar al Chiquillo. El coloso, furioso, le pide a Carmen que se vaya. Roro se subirá a la tarima a cantar, el Coloso quedara atónito al escuchar a su hijo.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rodrigo Román alias el Monumental continua ganándose el corazón del Coloso cantando en tarima. Por otro lado, el capitán Bernal y sus hombres llegan al bar Garibaldi con la fotografía del fugitivo Emiliano Sanchez Gallardo.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario continúa destrozada por la noticia que recibió por parte de la policía y decide quedarse encerrada. Por otro lado, Emiliano alista el traje de mariachi para devolverlo. El mexicano renuncia en el bar diciendo que se va para su país.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano busca hospedaje en la calle de la laguna. Mientras tanto, Javier Macías busca un apartamento de lujo para alquilarlo. Por otro lado, Carlos Malagón le comunica a los mariachis que Emiliano renuncio, Fernando decide salir a buscarlo.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Fernando y Sigifredo deciden buscar a Emiliano en la calle de la Laguna, se llevaran una gran sorpresa al ver a Emiliano borracho cantando en un bar. Emiliano terminara confesándole a Sigifredo toda la verdad sobre su verdadera identidad.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Sigifredo habla con Raquel sobre el paradero de Emiliano, Lucia los oye a escondidas. Por otro lado, Roberto Sanchez decide visitar al licenciado Miguel Corona para comentarle que están sospechando de Emiliano por la muerte de Martin del Valle.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Fernando intenta explicarle a Sigifredo las razones por las que encubrió a Emiliano. Fernando insiste en sacar a Emiliano de la laguna pero este sigue negándose. Por otro lado, el Coloso aprovecha la situación en la que esta Rosario para consolarla.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano sale con los mariachis del Maguey a dar serenatas. Por otro lado, Fernando va a la laguna para avisarle a Emiliano que Gabriela envió un correo. Fernando dejara el mensaje con Memo, quien aprovechara para proponerle trabajo al mexicano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano hace un pésimo arreglo con Memo para trabajar en el Maguey. El Mexicano cambiara canciones por comida y trago. Por otro lado, sin pensar y sin tener en cuenta las consecuencias, Lucia decide salir en busca de Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Un triste e incómodo encuentro entre Emiliano y Rosario en el bar el Maguey. El dolor que siente Emiliano al ver partir a la mujer que ama con otro hombre, lo llevara a seguir cometiendo errores.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano se niega a aceptar que su relación con Rosario se acabe y por esto decide salir a buscarla. Por otro lado, Verónica llama a Virginia para contarle que Emiliano está trabajando en el bar el Maguey.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Con ayuda de Sigifredo, Emiliano recupera los cuadernos de Lucia y reúne el dinero para comprarle una maleta nueva. Por otro lado, Javier Macías quiere ofrecerle dinero a Emiliano para que regrese a México.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Javier Macías decide ofrecerle dinero a Emiliano para que regrese a su país y deje en paz a Rosario. El mexicano perderá el control y golpeara al cínico abogado sin medir las consecuencias.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Adoptando el papel de víctima, Javier Macías le confiesa a Rosario que Emiliano lo golpeo cuando él intentaba ayudarlo. Por otro lado, Emiliano decide llevar a Virginia a su horrible habitación para que salga despavorida y deje de acosarlo.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Golpes vienen y van. Emiliano continúa dando serenatas en compañía del Coloso de Jalisco y el grupo del Maguey. El Coloso usara su ingenio para convencer a Emiliano de ir con Rosario a la universidad y darle una serenata.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario pasa por un momento bastantemente embarazoso cuando francisco le lleva una serenata al salón de clase. Mientras EL Coloso celebrar que El Mexicano le hizo caso y así en vez de ganar puntos con ella haría todo lo contrario.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano le pide disculpas a Rosario y le dice que recuerde que un día prometieron vivir uno junto al otro, que nunca la abandonará y luchará siempre por su amor, pero ella le dice que no la siga y que no la busque.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El coloso llega a buscar a Emiliano para burlarse más de él, pero el mexicano ya no tiene más paciencia y desata una pelea de grandes proporciones. Todos están a la expectativa del final de este encuentro.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Andres le dice a Rosario y a Leticia que la bronca con Molina y Lara, fue cosa de tragos, pero que si ellos no tienen límites, lo mejor es que ellas hablen con ellos y pongan esos límites.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Don Memo indaga para saber la verdad sobre Francisco, de donde viene, quien es en realidad, buscando darle la mejor oportunidad para que su vida tome un rumbo, pero el amor de Lara por Rosario no cederá e irá hasta las últimas consecuencias.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario llega al Bar donde canta Lara para hablar con él. Lara y Rosario se dedican canciones que llegarán hasta lo más profundo de sus corazones.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: La discusión entre Rosario y Francisco no tiene límites, toman como excusas serenatas contratadas para cantarse las verdades, lo cual les traerá muchos problemas. Todo dependerá de una buena tonada para solucionar sus diferencias.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Finalmente la reconciliación entre Francisco y Rosario se hace realidad, después de mucha discusión y de muchas suplicas por el perdón, el amor supera todos los obstáculos hasta el punto de pedirle un favor a Molina.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Es una nueva etapa para el amor, Francisco deja el pasado y le da paso a Emiliano para iniciar una relación sin ningún secreto con Rosario. Mientras su familia esta en México preparado un viaje secreto, esto traerá una nueva prueba para el amor .

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El amor apasionado entre Rosario y Emiliano renace, dando paso al perdón y a la reconciliación. Por otra parte, La madre de Rosario no está de acuerdo que su hija le haya dado otra oportunidad al mexicano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Es la última noche de Emiliano en La Laguna, les confiesa a sus compañeros que su reconciliación con Rosario fue un éxito. Mientras Carlos recibe una sorpresa por parte de Eulalia en el camerino, que hará que él se sienta muy orgulloso de ella.

programme.desc: Emiliano le tiene una gran sorpresa a Rosario, le da un anillo y le pide matrimonio por segunda vez, en esta oportunidad como Emiliano Sánchez Gallardo. Mientras el licenciado Corona llega a Bogotá y hace contacto con el detective.

programme.desc: "Franklin and Friends," based on the children's book series featuring Franklin, is a computer-animated series geared toward preschoolers that aims to teach the kids lessons. Franklin's friends referenced in the title include best friend Bear, problem-solving Snail, practical joker Rabbit, natural leader Beaver, inventive Fox and empathetic Goose. programme.title: Back To School
programme.desc: When the NEXO-Knights are sloppy in a fight with Jestro, Merlok 2.0 sends them back to the Knights' Academy. Not only for a brush-up but to find out what Jestro is after in its hallowed halls. As they Knights battle Jestro – in a somewhat haphazard and lazy way – they discuss the fact that Jestro never wins and that they're always getting over on him. Despite defeating the jerky Jester and his evil Book, Merlok 2.0 discovers that something about the attack on the village is tied to the Knights' Academy. It looks like that's where they'll strike next. It wouldn't hurt for the Knights to go “back to school” to watch for Jestro and for some refresher training. Merlok is sure Jestro wants something at the Academy, but he doesn't know what it is. The Knights are very much “fish out of water” at the academy, even with the “cool kids” – Robin and Ava – showing them around. The next generation of Knights is being taught to integrate the NEXO-Magic of Merlok into their fighting techniques and these kids are good (so good, they initially kick the lazy, know-it-all Knight's butts!) Their old principal, the ever-ornery Headmaster Brickland, sets them straight: they're all still slackers, and they better get their acts together (especially Lance!) The Knights take shifts as “library helpers” much to the delight of the old squirebot librarian, MARGE. They're convinced Jestro is after a book…isn't he always after a book? When Jestro attacks, the Knights help organize the students and there's a big fight in the Academy Library versus Jestro and his Monsters. They drive Jestro off without letting him steal any books! Victory! But as Jestro leaves, we see him holding what the Book of Monsters really wanted: a snow globe with a castle in it that was sitting on the librarian's desk. In the Lava Lands, Jestro throws the snow globe into a volcano and it frees the massive Castle of Monstrux from its snowy magic prison

programme.title: Yako, Cazador de Malditos
programme.desc: Yako tiene que vengarse del hombre que asesinó a su esposa embarazada.

programme.title: Malverde, la leyenda
programme.desc: En el norte de México, un famoso bandolero se gana a la gente al repartir parte del producto de sus robos entre la población.

programme.title: El Hechizo del Pantano
programme.desc: Un niño juega en el bosque con una chiquilla y cuando su padre se entera descubren que ella murió años atrás.

programme.title: El tesoro del amazonas
programme.desc: Un aventurero y sus amigos compiten contra un ex-nazi y otras personas que buscan un tesoro de diamantes en la selva sudamericana.

programme.title: Debieron ahorcarlos antes
programme.desc: Dos sujetos roban el oro del ejército, Silvestre es aprendido, pero el abuelo huye junto a Joe Oaxaca y el federal Tomás Bueno. Se desata un tiroteo del que tendrán que salir bien librados.

programme.title: Ha entrado una mujer
programme.desc: Una mujer que no pudo tener consigo a su hijo de pequeño lo encuentra de joven y lucha para ganar su aprecio.

programme.title: Los desalmados
programme.desc: Dos cazarrecompensas se convierten en fieles y buenos amigos, a pesar de los problemas debido a sus profesiones.

programme.title: El Hijo del Otro
programme.desc: Una mujer le habla de su embarazo a su esposo, un hombre estéril. Más tarde él descubre que fue inseminación artificial.

programme.title: Garra de Tigre
programme.desc: Un maestro de artes marciales cría a tres niños para que sean hombres de bien y sepan defenderse de "Garra de Tigre".

programme.title: El Mofles y los Mecánicos
programme.desc: Un mecánico se topa con unos ladrones que huyen de la policía quienes dejan caer una bolsa llena de dinero.

programme.title: Barridos y regados
programme.desc: Cuando dos mensajeros llegan con un recado a una empresa, los confunden con los técnicos a los que esperaban y ellos aprovechan la situación para ganar dinero e impresionar a las bellas secretarias.

programme.title: Mágico, el Enviado de los Dioses
programme.desc: Un héroe enmascarado llamado Mágico llega a la Tierra para pelear contra una fuerza maléfica y defender a los necesitados.

programme.title: Sor Batalla
programme.desc: Una monja es enviada a un pueblo lejano, gobernado por un hombre malvado, y con su fe y alegría intenta cambiarlo.

programme.title: Operación 67
programme.desc: Una banda oriental intenta falsificar las placas con que se imprimen los billetes de un país latino para desestabilizarlo.

programme.title: Los supersabios
programme.desc: Los supersabios construyen un cohete espacial. Panza Y Pola provocan la curiosidad de los villanos Solomillo y el médico. Los muchachos despegan su nave y se encuentran con Panza y Pola para comenzar a explorar.

programme.title: El tesoro de Moctezuma
programme.desc: Santo y dos agentes enfrentan a unos villanos cuando se tratan de robar el tesoro de Moctezuma.

programme.title: Asesinos comerciantes de niños
programme.desc: Los padres de un niño secuestrado se enfrentan a una banda criminal que trafica con órganos humanos de menores.

programme.title: Duelo en El Dorado

programme.title: The World's Greatest Churches

programme.title: The History and Achievements of the Islamic Golden Age

programme.sub-title: Senet: Egypt's Game of the Afterlife
